long_biography.plain_text:
Schraad Sales & Marketing developed beyond its original food-brokerage model under Bill Schraad Jr.'s leadership. He steered the Oklahoma City company into fresh produce and natural and speciality foods while retaining its established work with packaged grocery brands. The agency also joined peers in other US regions to build the On Shelf Marketing Group, giving manufacturers a coordinated brokerage network without abandoning local retailer relationships.

Schraad remains chairman and chief executive of the business his father established. An Oklahoma State graduate, he has championed regional food banks where the agency operates. He also serves on the Oklahoma chapter's executive council of the Alzheimer's Association, a cause the company says is personal to the Schraad family.
